name: Corridor
source:
King sends three princes on a journey so that the prince who gets the most wonderful journey becomes his successor. The player prince is searching for the legendary cursed castle to become next king.

[From [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1984.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
国王派3位王子外出游历，并宣布经历最精彩旅程的人将成为他的继承者。玩家扮演的王子为了登上王位，决定去寻找传说中遭受诅咒的城堡。

[引自[url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1984.html]vndbreview[/url]]
